item.title: Kumamoto Events 2026: Festivals, Aso & Visiting After the Earthquake
item.description: Kumamoto, in the heart of Kyushu, is a prefecture of extraordinary landscapes and warm hospitality — the mighty reconstruction of Kumamoto Castle, the vast volcanic caldera of Mt. Aso, the misty riverside hot springs of Kurokawa Onsen, and a proud tradition of summer and autumn festivals. This guide gathers the events worth knowing for 2026, along with the timeless sights that make Kumamoto rewarding to visit year-round. ⚠️ Important — the 2026 Kumamoto earthquake: In late July 2026 Kumamoto was struck by an earthquake, and as a result many of the prefecture’s 2026 summer festivals were cancelled or greatly scaled back out of concern for safety and for those affected.
